intro.ja: 「4枚落ち定跡」で学んだ形を、実際に手順を指して確認します。
intro.en: Play through the moves to check what you learned in “Four-piece handicap”.

courses.title: 4枚落ち定跡・練習問題: 4枚落ちの飛車先交換と端攻め準備
courses.titleEn: Four-piece handicap practice: Four-piece handicap: rook-pawn exchange and edge preparation
courses.goalFormation: 4枚落ちの飛車先交換と端攻め準備

branches.note: 学習用の基本手順。上手から指し、銀を中央へ進める。
branches.noteEn: Teaching sequence; adapt to different replies. White moves first and develops the silver toward the center.
Open the bishop diagonal.
Advance White’s central pawn.
Advance Black’s rook pawn.

branches.note: 銀を5三へ上げ、中央を支える。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 5c to support the center.
Claim more space on the second file.

branches.note: 金を3二へ寄せ、右側を守る。
branches.noteEn: Bring the gold to 3b to defend White’s king-side wing.
Sacrifice the second-file pawn to open the rook file.
Capture the attacking second-file pawn.

branches.note: 飛車で歩を取り、持ち歩と2五の空間を得る。
branches.noteEn: Capture with the rook to obtain a pawn in hand and clear 2e.

branches.note: 歩を打って飛車を追う。
branches.noteEn: Drop a pawn to drive the rook back.

branches.note: 飛車を引き、銀の進出を準備する。
branches.noteEn: Withdraw the rook and prepare the silver advance.
Bring White’s gold to 7b.

branches.note: 銀を3八へ上げ、棒銀の進出を始める。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 3h to begin the Climbing Silver route.
Move White’s king to 5b.

branches.note: 銀を2七へ進め、飛車先の攻めへ向ける。
branches.noteEn: Develop the silver to 2g toward the rook-pawn attack.
Recapture the bishop with the silver.

branches.note: 銀を3六へ上げ、2五へ進む道を作る。
branches.noteEn: Advance the silver to 3f on its route to 2e.
Advance White’s seventh-file pawn.
Advance the edge pawn.
Move the gold to 7c.

branches.note: 端歩を伸ばし、銀と協力する攻めを準備する。
branches.noteEn: Advance the edge pawn to prepare a coordinated silver attack.
Move the gold to 6d.

branches.note: 銀を2五へ進め、1筋と2筋を狙う。
branches.noteEn: Place the silver on 2e to pressure both the first and second files.
